verdict.rationale: Jitsu runs its own pipeline work unattended in the background. Functions execute on every incoming event to filter, transform, or enrich it, and can call external services via the Fetch API and keep state in persistent storage. Connector syncs run on a recurring schedule as Kubernetes CronJobs, and a dead-letter reprocessing worker replays failed events. These are data-pipeline automations, not general-purpose autonomous automations, and the recurring-schedule evidence comes only from self-hosting docs. Missing for 10: user-facing docs for configuring schedules or triggers, general-purpose automation beyond event processing and syncs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
